source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the appliance or disconnect power before resistance checks and board access. Live voltage steps require controls off and safe access. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Power on before CONNECT
steps.body: Appliance ON (POWER pressed). Press CONNECT — does WiFi console icon light or blink?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Appliance ON (POWER pressed). Press CONNECT — does WiFi console icon light or blink?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: WiFi icon dead — run WiFi module procedure.

steps.title: Recycle power
steps.body: Unplug 60 seconds. Restore power and repeat connect. If still failing and appliance otherwise OK, check software versions.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug 60 seconds. Restore power and repeat connect. If still failing and appliance otherwise OK, check software versions.

steps.title: Software versions or WiFi LED?
steps.body: Can you read WiFi (n) version in Service Diagnostic? If no, inspect WiFi module LED during connect.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Can you read WiFi (n) version in Service Diagnostic? If no, inspect WiFi module LED during connect.

steps.title: Home network / WISE / registration
steps.oemOutcome: Appliance smart layer OK — refer customer to router/WPS/WPA-2 and Whirlpool Help Line 866-333-4591 for HAN issues.

steps.title: Run WiFi module test
steps.oemOutcome: Proceed with w10785366a-wifi-module and HMI communication procedures.
